caption: The image is a drawing of what appears to be the cover of a portfolio or booklet, rendered to look three-dimensional with visible edges suggesting thickness. The main central rectangular area is filled with a flat gray color, bordered by a lighter edge that mimics the appearance of a book cover. In the center of the gray area, there is a black and white illustration of an eagle with its wings spread, holding an olive branch in one talon and a cluster of arrows in the other; a banner above the eagle’s head reads "FEDERAL UNION." Surrounding the eagle is text, all in uppercase, light gray or white, and centered, which reads: "A Silk Screen Printing Of Early Connecticut Wall Decorations" at the top and "From The Index Of American Design Connecticut Art Project Work Projects Administration Washington, D.C." at the bottom. The drawing is decorated with three red ribbon ties depicted on the left, right, and bottom edges, adding to the look of a tied portfolio. The background outside the central rectangle is light beige, and underneath the illustration, there is handwritten text in pencil: "A Perspective Drawing of Completed Portfolio Cover, small ii, gray cardboard." There is also a signature on the bottom right of the drawing.
title: A Silk Screen Printing of Early Connecticut Wall Decorations, Portfolio Cover
